# Full Audit Checklist: Auth Screens

**Purpose**: Comprehensive requirements quality audit covering UX/Forms, Security, Accessibility, and Edge Cases
**Created**: 2026-02-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth**: Standard (~30 items)
**Audience**: Reviewer (PR/pre-release gate)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are input field `maxLength` constraints specified for all text inputs (name, email, password)? Name has 2-50, but email and password have no upper bound defined. [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are focus management requirements defined for page transitions between auth routes (e.g., autofocus on first field)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the exact visual representation of password strength levels specified (colors, segment widths, text labels for each level)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements for the "Viably" logo defined with specific dimensions, spacing, and click behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are form field `autocomplete` attribute requirements specified to support browser autofill (e.g., `autocomplete="email"`, `autocomplete="new-password"`)? [Completeness, Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is "loading state on the submit button" (FR-015) specified as shimmer effect, spinner, text change, or combination? Spec says "visual shimmer effect + disabled state" but shimmer is not defined. [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "approximately 45% width" for the decorative panel quantified with exact value or acceptable range? [Clarity, Spec §US4-AS1]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are the 4 password strength rules explicitly mapped to the 4 strength levels (which combination of rules = which level)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "shake animation" specified with duration, easing, displacement distance, and trigger conditions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 - Is the social proof stat text consistent across spec ("1,200+ bots deployed") and implementation requirements? Spec §FR-003 defines it but no update mechanism is specified. [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are error message formats consistent across all three forms (toast vs inline vs both)? FR-007 mentions field-level + shake, FR-016 mentions toast for server errors — is the combination always the same? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the redirect target consistently defined? FR-017 says "dashboard", FR-020 says "dashboard" — but is `/dashboard` the exact path in all cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, §FR-020]

## Security Requirements

- [ ] CHK013 - Are CSRF protection requirements defined for auth form submissions? [Security, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are rate limiting requirements specified for login and forgot-password submissions to prevent brute force? [Security, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the session cookie specification defined (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite, expiration, path)? Proxy checks cookie existence but cookie attributes are not specified. [Security, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are requirements specified for preventing user enumeration via forgot-password error messages ("No account found" reveals account existence)? [Security, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are XSS protection requirements defined for user input rendering (name field, email display in forgot-password success)? [Security, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the proxy redirect behavior specified for nested protected routes (e.g., `/dashboard/settings`) or only exact `/dashboard` match? [Security, Spec §FR-020]

## Accessibility Requirements

- [ ] CHK019 - Are keyboard navigation requirements explicitly defined for all interactive elements (tab order, Enter to submit, Escape to close)? [Accessibility, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are screen reader announcement requirements specified for dynamic state changes (form errors, password strength updates, success states)? [Accessibility, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are color contrast requirements specified for all text on the decorative gradient panel (tagline, badge text on gradient background)? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are `aria-live` region requirements defined for the password strength indicator to announce changes to assistive technology? [Accessibility, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the `prefers-reduced-motion` behavior specified for all animations (glow orbs, shake, button loading)? Plan mentions support but spec doesn't define fallback behavior. [Accessibility, Gap]

## Edge Case & Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for handling network failures mid-submission (not just server errors, but connection loss)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements specified for browser back/forward navigation behavior on auth pages (form state preservation, redirect loops)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is behavior defined when user is on forgot-password success state and refreshes the page? Should it show the form again or persist the success state? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are requirements defined for concurrent tab behavior (user logs in on tab A while tab B shows login page)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the "very long string" edge case (Spec Edge Cases §3) quantified with specific character limits for each field? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge-3]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK029 - Are SC-001 ("under 30 seconds") and SC-002 ("under 2 minutes") measurable under defined conditions (network speed, device type, user familiarity)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is SC-004 ("320px to 2560px") tested at specific breakpoints or just the extremes? Are intermediate breakpoints (768px, 1024px, 1440px) defined as test points? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 - Is the assumption "dashboard route exists as redirect target" (Assumption §3) validated, and are requirements defined for what happens if dashboard is not yet implemented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are Terms of Service and Privacy Policy page requirements defined, or is the placeholder behavior specified (links exist in register form but targets are undefined)? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions §4]
